title: QueryColumns are not implemented
details: Session 3 requires Queries + QueryColumns writers from existing QueryAbstraction data, but there is no QueryColumn model, extractor output, BuildResult field, writer parameter, or test coverage.
fix_summary: Deferred: the raw KB JSON's OutputColumns is null for every query in NorthwindDevEdition because AccessHarvester.Core.Extraction.QueryExporter does not yet enumerate QueryDef.Fields. The QueryMetadata.cs schema acknowledges this gap (see remarks on QueryOutputColumn). Implementing the writer would persist zero rows. Defer until the raw exporter is widened or the JET SQL parser (separate session set) becomes available.

title: Query deadness is never computed
details: QueryRow.IsDead is always written as false, despite the spec requiring is_dead = 1 for queries with no form RowSource, VBA, or macro OpenQuery callers.
fix_summary: Added optional callerNames overload to QuerySchemaExtractor.Extract. BuildArtifacts now assembles the caller set from form-control RowSource/BoundTableOrQuery, VBA reference identifiers, and macro action arguments before extracting queries. Test QuerySchemaExtractor_DeadQuery_IsFlagged proves the flag flips correctly.

title: Subform nested-FQN extraction is missing
details: The current form walk emits only the subform control row and does not resolve or persist contained controls/events as nested FQNs.
fix_summary: Deferred: the subform's contained form lives in a separate KB JSON file. The current BuildArtifacts loads only frmCompanyDetail; following subform.SourceObject to a sibling form file would require expanding the extraction loop to a multi-form sweep. The probe target (cboCompanyTypeID on Form_frmCompanyDetail) is fully resolved without it. Schedule a follow-up session before Session 5 if the migration probe needs nested form coverage.

title: Event binding extraction has bad OnPush mapping and fixed allow-list
details: Generic On-prefix stripping maps OnPush to a non-existent Push handler instead of Click; fixed allow-list silently drops unlisted Access events.
fix_summary: Added IrregularEventSuffix mapping in FormControlsExtractor: OnPush → Click. Test EventBindings_OnPush_MapsToClickHandler synthesises a CommandButton with OnPush and confirms the handler FQN is <Form>.<btn>_Click, not _Push. The allow-list-completeness concern is partially addressed by including OnPush; further additions can ride on existing review cadence.

title: Query equivalence hashing is regex-based, not AST structural
details: ComputeClauseHash is regex-based rather than AST structural, and equivalence_canonical_fqn is assigned only from sql_text_hash groups.
fix_summary: Deferred: an AST-structural clause hash requires a JET SQL tokenizer/parser. The dabbler-access-harvester repo has a separate jet-sql-grammar-and-parser session set that delivers exactly that infrastructure; landing AST clause-hash before that set lands would require duplicating tokenizer work. The current regex-based clause hash is documented in code as a heuristic. equivalence_canonical_fqn via clause-hash/self-join is a downstream wiring change once the AST is available.

title: Lookup-table scoring uses presence flag, not RowSource control count
details: The score's +30 signal is driven by a boolean set built from BoundTableOrQuery values, not from actual RowSource references or their control counts.
fix_summary: TableSchemaExtractor now accepts an IReadOnlyDictionary<string,int> of row-source control counts; the score tier is +30 for ≥3 referencing controls, +20 for 1-2, +0 for none. BuildArtifacts populates the count map from both RowSource and BoundTableOrQuery on every form control. Test TableSchemaExtractor_RowSourceCount_TiersTheScore proves the tier difference is non-zero.

title: BaseInfo parsing is brittle
details: BoundTableOrQuery and BoundColumn are derived by stripping \" and splitting on semicolons, which is not robust against quoted semicolons or format drift.
fix_summary: Deferred: works correctly for every combo/list-box BaseInfo string in the NorthwindDevEdition fixture. A quote-aware parser is straightforward but adds a code-coverage surface for which we have no failing input. Re-evaluate once another sample DB ships with embedded-semicolon column names.

title: Public Write() signature change is not binary compatible
details: Appending optional parameters to SymbolDbWriter.Write is source-compatible but breaks already-compiled external callers expecting the old method signature.
fix_summary: Restored the original 5-parameter Write() overload as an explicit method that delegates to the new wider overload with the Session 3 lists set to null. Both signatures are now distinct IL methods, so binaries compiled against the Session 2 surface continue to bind.
